title: Profiling
description: Schema for a data profiling result. Captures statistical and structural analysis of a source data object including null rates, distinct counts, type conformance, pattern candidates, PII indicators, and anomaly flags. Supports metadata-only, aggregate query, and sample query access modes.

profile_id.description: Unique identifier for this profiling result.

source_system.description: Identifier of the source system containing the profiled object.

source_object.description: Fully qualified name of the table, view, or file profiled.

profiled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when profiling was performed.

profiled_by.description: Identity of the person or agent that performed the profiling.

row_count_approx.description: Approximate row count of the source object at time of profiling.

sample_size.description: Number of rows included in the profiling sample (0 if metadata_only).

access_mode.description: Mode used to access the data for profiling.

physical_type.description: Physical data type of the column as declared in the source.

null_count.description: Number of null values in the sample.

null_pct.description: Percentage of null values in the sample.

distinct_count.description: Number of distinct non-null values in the sample.

distinct_pct.description: Percentage of distinct non-null values relative to total non-null rows.

min_length.description: Minimum string length observed in the sample.

max_length.description: Maximum string length observed in the sample.

pattern_candidates.description: Regular expression patterns that describe the observed value formats.

type_conformance_pct.description: Percentage of values that conform to the declared physical type.

uniqueness_candidate.description: Indicates whether this column is a candidate for a unique key based on profiling.

referential_candidates.description: Candidate foreign key references identified based on value overlap analysis.

anomaly_flags.description: Anomalies detected in this column (e.g. outliers, unexpected nulls, format violations).

pii_candidate.description: PII candidate assessment for this column.

value.description: Indicates whether this column is considered a PII candidate.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the PII candidate assessment (e.g. high, medium, low).

redaction_applied.description: Indicates whether redaction was applied to the profiling output to protect sensitive values.

query_fingerprint.description: Hash or fingerprint of the query used to generate the profiling sample, for reproducibility.
